title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Cost Share by Sponsor Pay Grade: Training Notes on Tier Changes
content:
> The Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) monthly cost share is set by the sponsor's pay grade through the tier. A promotion or reduction moves the registration to the tier of the new grade under the tier change effective rule (from the first calendar month after DEERS records the new grade); a month already assessed is not re-rated.

Each of the ten ECHO tiers applies its own monthly cost share, the amount listed for that tier in the product's monthly cost share schedule: Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-1 to E-5; Sponsor E-6; Sponsor E-7 and O-1; Sponsor E-8 and O-2; Sponsor E-9, W-1, W-2 and O-3; Sponsor W-3, W-4 and O-4; Sponsor W-5 and O-5; Sponsor O-6 and O-7; Sponsor O-8; and Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor O-9 and O-10.

## Questions the rule answers

**What decides which monthly cost share a family pays?**
The sponsor's pay grade. The pay grade places the registration in a tier, and the tier's monthly cost share is the amount.

**Does a promotion or a reduction in grade change the tier?**
Yes. Either one moves the registration to the tier of the new grade. The move records the new tier and the first calendar month in which the new tier's cost share applies.

**From when does the new tier apply?**
From the first calendar month after DEERS records the new grade. The month in which DEERS records it stays in the earlier tier.

**What happens to a month that was already assessed?**
It is not re-rated. A cost share already assessed keeps the amount at which it was assessed.

## Hypothetical timeline, for illustration only

*Hypothetical facts:* a sponsor is reduced in grade, and DEERS records the new grade on a day in September.

| Month | Tier in effect for the month |
|---|---|
| August | the tier of the earlier grade |
| September (DEERS records the new grade) | the tier of the earlier grade |
| October | the tier of the new grade |
| November onward | the tier of the new grade |

A cost share for August that was assessed before the change is not re-rated.
